# Vendor

Third-party code copied into this repo (no pip/npm).

## markdown2.py

- **Project:** [trentm/python-markdown2](https://github.com/trentm/python-markdown2)
- **File:** upstream `lib/markdown2.py`
- **Version:** 2.5.6 (at time of vendoring)
- **License:** MIT (see header in `markdown2.py`)
- **Why:** zero-dependency Markdown → HTML for the local blog build

Upgrade: replace `markdown2.py` with a newer `lib/markdown2.py` from upstream and re-run the site build.
